description: Register tablet app for the UK POS pilot (Build-04 Objective 1): offline-first sell screen, Challenge 25 gate, split tender + W-12 unknown-payment screen, till session flow, hardware adapters, and local SQLite storage with delta-sync to the API. Pure/testable TypeScript — no React Native runtime dependency; the view-models are framework-free so they can be bound to a React Native UI later.
name: @uk-pos/register-app
